fee_notes: Royalty is 2% of total gross sales, payable monthly on the 10th day of the following month. Gross sales excludes sales tax and use tax. Advertising fee is 'up to 1% of total gross sales' but is not currently charged. Operating assistance fees currently ~$25/hr ($37.50 OT) plus $150/day for chef/manager, and $10/hr ($15 OT) plus $250/day for server, charged only for extraordinary assistance or franchisee failure to follow standards. Transfer fee: $2,500. Late payment penalty: 5% of late payment (60+ days overdue). Interest on late payments: lesser of legal limit or 1.5%/month. Liquidated damages for post-term covenant violation: 5% of gross receipts of competing business.
raw_excerpt:
Royalty1/ 2% of total gross sales Payable monthly on the 10th day of the next month Gross sales means all revenue from the franchise location, but excludes sales tax and use tax
Stabilizer base1/ Currently, $68.06 for 50 lbs. plus actual shipping costs 30 days after billing Necessary ingredient for operation, price will increase over time
Operating assistance1/ See note 2 30 days after billing Applies to extraordinary assistance, need due to your failure to follow system standards, or at your request
Advertising fee1/ Up to 1% of total gross sales Same as Royalty fee We do not currently charge an advertising fee. (See Item 11)
Transfer Fee1/ $2,500 Prior to or at time of approval Applies to transfers of a controlling interest
Additional training at our designated facility1/ No current fee/any fee must not exceed $5,000 30 days after billing Applies to new managers or refresher training - no such charges currently imposed
Testing fee1/ Our actual costs 30 days after billing Applies to franchisee request to change regulated products, no such charges currently imposed
Manuals1/ Our actual costs 30 days after billing Applies to replacement of lost, damaged or destroyed manuals, no such charges currently imposed
Relocation fee1/ Our actual costs Prior to or at time of approval Applies if you are allowed to relocate the Restaurant
Audits1/ Our actual costs 30 days after billing Applies only if audit shows an understatement of at least 2% of gross sales for any month
Penalty on late Payments1/ 5% of late payment NA Applies to all payments 60 days or more overdue
Interest on late Payments1/ Lesser of legal limit or 1.5% per month NA Applies to all overdue payments to us as of the date of the underpayment. Interest on late payments begins to accrue on the day after the payment is due.
Indemnification1/ Our actual costs As incurred by us Applies to actions against us because of your Restaurant operation
Costs and Attorney Fees1/ Our actual costs and fees NA Payable if we need to enforce payment provisions against you
Liquidated Damages1/ 5% of gross receipts of a competitive business operated in violation of the post-term covenant not to compete NA Applies only if you violate your post-term covenant not to compete
